title: 化学需氧量与测定安全

author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/33_What is COD , COD removal formula, Chemical Oxygen Demand laboratory microbiolog/src.py

points.S1: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
points.S3: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置
points.S4: 废水样本，也当生物危害对待

shots.scene: 欣欣站在环境实验室里，身旁一排装着彩色液体的小试管，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in an environmental lab next to a rack of small capped tubes with orange to green liquids, waving at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到实验室课堂。
overlay: 化学需氧量与测定安全

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一杯浑浊的水
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a beaker of cloudy water.
shots.narration: 今天学一个水质指标，再说测定安全。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着两瓶水样：一瓶浑浊，一瓶清澈
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds two sample bottles with blank labels: one cloudy, one clear.
shots.narration: 阿杰在污水处理课题组实习。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，头顶出现问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head with a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 他问：处理效果怎么用数字说清？

shots.scene: 小研拿出空白记录本，写下三个空格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank notebook and draws three empty boxes.
shots.narration: 小研说：先认识COD。

shots.scene: 水滴里有树叶、油滴和小颗粒图标
shots.prompt_en: A large water droplet icon containing small leaf, oil drop and particle icons. No people.
shots.narration: 水里有各种能被氧化的物质，

shots.scene: 氧气小球飞进水滴，把颗粒一个个消掉
shots.prompt_en: Small oxygen bubble icons fly into the droplet and the particles disappear one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 用化学方法把它们氧化掉，

shots.scene: 旁边一个计数器记下消耗的氧气小球
shots.prompt_en: A counter beside the droplet tallies the oxygen bubbles used up. No people.
shots.narration: 消耗的氧量，就是化学需氧量。

shots.scene: 一个刻度尺，单位标注 mg/L
shots.prompt_en: A measuring scale icon with marks from low to high. No people.
shots.narration: 它用每升多少毫克来表示。

shots.scene: 刻度从低到高，水滴从清到浊
shots.prompt_en: Along the scale, water droplet icons change from clear at the low end to murky brown at the high end. No people.
shots.narration: 数值越高，水的污染越重。

shots.scene: 污水管和河流两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a wastewater pipe and a natural river. No people.
shots.narration: 污水和天然水体都能用它衡量。

shots.scene: 污水从左边流进一个处理池，从右边流出变清
shots.prompt_en: Murky water flows into a treatment tank on the left and comes out clearer on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 污水经过处理，

shots.scene: 左边高柱、右边矮柱的柱形图
shots.prompt_en: A simple bar chart: a tall bar on the left, a short bar on the right, with a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: COD降下来多少，就是COD去除。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白公式卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank formula card.
shots.narration: 怎么算去除了多少？

shots.scene: 两根柱子相减，差值再除以左边高柱
shots.prompt_en: The short bar is subtracted from the tall bar; the difference is then compared with the tall bar as a fraction. No people.
shots.narration: 进水减出水，再除以进水，

shots.scene: 分数变成一个百分号
shots.prompt_en: The fraction turns into a large percent sign. No people.
shots.narration: 乘以一百，就是去除率。

shots.scene: 处理池入口的水滴标“进”，出口的水滴标“出”
shots.prompt_en: At the treatment tank, an arrow marks the inlet water droplet and another arrow marks the outlet water droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 进水，是处理前的COD浓度；

shots.scene: 出口水滴发亮
shots.prompt_en: The outlet water droplet glows. No people.
shots.narration: 出水，是处理后的COD浓度。

shots.scene: 两个水滴下方都标着同样的单位
shots.prompt_en: Both droplets show the same unit tag beneath them. No people.
shots.narration: 两个数单位要一致。

shots.scene: 小研在空白记录本上写下两个数
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes two numbers on the blank notebook.
shots.narration: 举个例子：进水五百，出水一百。

shots.scene: 五百减一百得四百，四百除以五百
shots.prompt_en: A simple calculation animation: five hundred minus one hundred gives four hundred, then divided by five hundred. No people.
shots.narration: 差四百，除以五百，

shots.scene: 大号的百分之八十闪亮出现
shots.prompt_en: A large eighty percent figure appears with sparkles. No people.
shots.narration: 去除率是百分之八十。

shots.scene: 阿杰竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student gives a thumbs up next to the treatment tank model.
shots.narration: 说明处理去掉了八成的COD。

shots.scene: 放大镜照着水滴
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass examines a water droplet. No people.
shots.narration: 为什么要测COD？

shots.scene: 水滴里两类颗粒：绿色的会被细菌吃掉，灰色的不会
shots.prompt_en: Inside the droplet are two kinds of particles: green ones that bacteria can eat, and grey ones they cannot. No people.
shots.narration: 它反映能被氧化的污染物总量，

shots.scene: 两类颗粒一起被计数
shots.prompt_en: Both green and grey particles are counted together by a counter. No people.
shots.narration: 能降解的、难降解的都算在内。

shots.scene: 两张卡：一张画细菌，一张画化学瓶
shots.prompt_en: Two cards: one with a bacterium icon, the other with a chemical bottle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还有一个指标叫生化需氧量。

shots.scene: 细菌卡只圈住绿色颗粒
shots.prompt_en: The bacterium card circles only the green particles. No people.
shots.narration: BOD只算细菌能分解的部分，

shots.scene: 化学瓶卡圈住全部颗粒
shots.prompt_en: The chemical bottle card circles all the particles, green and grey. No people.
shots.narration: COD两类都测，范围更全。

shots.section_title: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
shots.scene: 试管架上一排消解管，旁边亮起警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A rack of capped digestion tubes with a warning triangle glowing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 原片配图的消解管，藏着危险。
overlay: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀

shots.section_title: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
shots.scene: 三个象形图：氧化性、腐蚀性、健康危害
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard pictograms: oxidizer flame over circle, corrosion, and health hazard. No people.
shots.narration: 常用的方法要用强氧化剂和浓酸，

shots.section_title: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
shots.scene: 重金属小瓶旁边骷髅象形图
shots.prompt_en: Small reagent bottles with blank labels next to a skull and crossbones pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 有的还含银盐、汞盐，有毒。

shots.section_title: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜、面屏、耐酸手套，在通风柜里取试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing goggles, a face shield and acid-resistant gloves, handles reagents inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 在通风柜里操作，防护戴齐。

shots.section_title: 测COD的试剂：强氧化、强腐蚀
shots.scene: 王老师在空白领用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank chemical issue logbook as the female graduate student receives a bottle.
shots.narration: 这些试剂按管控化学品领用登记。

shots.scene: 消解器上一排管子在加热，冒着热气
shots.prompt_en: A heating block with a row of digestion tubes giving off heat waves. No people.
shots.narration: 测定要加热消解。

shots.scene: 管子破裂、液体喷溅的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked tube spraying hot liquid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 管子有裂纹，加热会破裂喷溅，

shots.scene: 小研用前逐支检查管子，再放进加热器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks each tube for cracks before placing it in the heating block, behind a closed fume hood sash.
shots.narration: 用前查管子，在通风柜里加热，

shots.scene: 计时器图标，小研等管子冷却后才用试管夹取出
shots.prompt_en: A timer icon; the female graduate student waits for the tubes to cool, then removes them with tube tongs.
shots.narration: 冷却后再用夹子取，不用手拿。

shots.section_title: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置
shots.scene: 废液倒进水池的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tube pouring waste liquid into a sink, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 测完的废液，绝不倒下水道。
overlay: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置

shots.section_title: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置
shots.scene: 小研把废液倒进贴空白标签的专用桶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours the waste into a dedicated closed container with a blank label, set in a spill tray.
shots.narration: 含铬、含汞，单独收集，

shots.section_title: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置
shots.scene: 专用桶和普通废液桶分开放，中间打叉不混
shots.prompt_en: The dedicated container sits apart from a general waste container, with a crossed-out mixing arrow between them. No people.
shots.narration: 不和其他废液混装，

shots.section_title: 含铬含汞废液，按危废处置
shots.scene: 回收车把专用桶运走
shots.prompt_en: A cart carries the dedicated container away for the school's hazardous waste pickup. No people.
shots.narration: 交学校按危险废物处置。

shots.section_title: 废水样本，也当生物危害对待
shots.scene: 阿杰在污水池边取样
shots.prompt_en: The young male student collects a water sample from a wastewater tank.
shots.narration: 污水样本里，可能有病原菌。
overlay: 废水样本，也当生物危害对待

shots.section_title: 废水样本，也当生物危害对待
shots.scene: 阿杰戴手套、护目镜，样本瓶拧紧放进转运盒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears gloves and goggles, caps the sample bottle tightly and places it in a closed transport box.
shots.narration: 取样戴手套，样本瓶拧紧，

shots.section_title: 废水样本，也当生物危害对待
shots.scene: 阿杰在水池边洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student washes his hands at a sink after removing his gloves.
shots.narration: 操作完摘手套，认真洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着三个图标：水滴、公式卡、两张对比卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to three icons: a water droplet, a formula card, and two comparison cards.
shots.narration: COD衡量水的污染，

shots.scene: 公式卡上显示百分之八十
shots.prompt_en: The formula card shows a large eighty percent figure. No people.
shots.narration: 进减出、除以进，就是去除率。

shots.scene: 三个图标：氧化性象形图、加热器、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: an oxidizer pictogram, a heating block, and a closed waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 测定时防腐蚀、防烫伤、废液不乱倒。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿戴整齐，在通风柜前看小研演示
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a lab coat and goggles, watches the female graduate student work at a fume hood.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：算得清，还要测得安全！

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the female graduate student wave goodbye in the lab.
shots.narration: 数据要准，人要安全，下次见！
